'''DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Joe Alread]] won the Friday heat, out of 8 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw11_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Iron Man], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031231930/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (Iron Man)
* '''Format:''' [[Iron Man]]<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Friday 12 November 1999, 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; Sunday 14 November 1999, 8 a.m.–1 p.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia

Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that Alread shredded high-profile cards, including an Enhanced Premiere Vader for a persona replacement, and won the Friday heat.<ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref>
